standard: IEEE 1800-2023 6.21 permits a `static` declaration in an automatic task, and makes it one variable for every call; 8.6 makes class methods automatic, so a class task keeps state the same way; 26.3 and 8.23 permit the package-scoped task call tick_pkg::tick(b) and the class-scoped call Counter#(1)::bump(c1). The two ticks give 1 and 2, as do the two bumps.
